name: social_buzz_score_ig
description: Total engagement volume across Instagram influencer and brand posts. Aggregates likes and comments from influencer posts that mention the brand, and likes, comments, reshares, and video plays from brand-owned Instagram posts. Sample input: "What's our total Instagram buzz this week?", "How much engagement did we get on Instagram?", "Show me the combined likes and comments from our influencer and brand posts on Instagram.", "What is the social buzz score for Instagram last month?"
formula: SUM(likes_count + comments_count + shares_count + views_count + saves_count + reposts_count)
formula_description: IG buzz: PacSun infl posts + brand posts

name: sentiment_score_ig
description: Average sentiment of comments across Instagram influencer and brand posts, ranging from -1 (fully negative) to +1 (fully positive). Computed by assigning +1 to positive, -1 to negative, and 0 to neutral comments from both sources combined. Sample input: "Is the sentiment in Instagram comments mostly positive or negative?", "What's the overall comment sentiment on our Instagram posts?", "How are people reacting to our Instagram content this quarter?", "Show me sentiment score for Instagram influencer and brand posts."
formula: SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE sentiment WHEN 'positive' THEN 1 WHEN 'neutral' THEN 0 WHEN 'negative' THEN -1 END), NULLIF(COUNTIF(sentiment IS NOT NULL), 0))

name: social_trend_velocity_ig
description: Week-over-week percentage change in Instagram social buzz, indicating how fast engagement is growing or declining. Positive values indicate growth; negative values indicate a drop in buzz. Sample input: "What's the rate of change in our Instagram engagement?", "Is our Instagram buzz growing or slowing down?", "Show me the trend velocity for Instagram week over week.", "How fast is our Instagram social buzz changing?"
formula_description: IG weekly buzz vs prior week, % change

name: post_engagement_rate_ig
description: Ratio of total Instagram engagements to total reach, expressed as a percentage. Measures how effectively content drives interaction relative to its audience size across both influencer and brand posts. Sample input: "What's the engagement rate on our Instagram posts?", "How well are our Instagram influencer posts performing relative to their reach?", "Show me Instagram post engagement rate for this month.", "What percentage of our Instagram audience is engaging with our content?"

name: social_buzz_score_tt
description: Total engagement volume across TikTok influencer and brand posts. Aggregates likes, comments, shares, and views from influencer posts mentioning the brand, and all interaction signals from brand-owned TikTok posts. Sample input: "What's our total TikTok buzz this week?", "How much engagement did we get on TikTok?", "Show me the combined likes, shares, and views from our TikTok influencer and brand posts.", "What is the social buzz score for TikTok last month?"
formula: SUM(likes_count + comments_count + shares_count + views_count + saves_count + reposts_count)
formula_description: TT buzz: PacSun infl posts + brand posts

name: sentiment_score_tt
description: Average sentiment of comments across TikTok influencer and brand posts, ranging from -1 (fully negative) to +1 (fully positive). Computed by assigning +1 to positive, -1 to negative, and 0 to neutral comments from both sources combined. Sample input: "Is the sentiment in TikTok comments mostly positive or negative?", "What's the overall comment sentiment on our TikTok posts?", "How are people reacting to our TikTok content this quarter?", "Show me sentiment score for TikTok influencer and brand posts."
formula: SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE sentiment WHEN 'positive' THEN 1 WHEN 'neutral' THEN 0 WHEN 'negative' THEN -1 END), NULLIF(COUNTIF(sentiment IS NOT NULL), 0))

name: social_trend_velocity_tt
description: Week-over-week percentage change in TikTok social buzz, indicating how fast engagement is growing or declining. Positive values indicate growth; negative values indicate a drop in buzz. Sample input: "What's the rate of change in our TikTok engagement?", "Is our TikTok buzz growing or slowing down?", "Show me the trend velocity for TikTok week over week.", "How fast is our TikTok social buzz changing?"
formula_description: TT weekly buzz vs prior week, % change

name: post_engagement_rate_tt
description: Ratio of total TikTok engagements to total reach, expressed as a percentage. Measures how effectively content drives interaction relative to its audience size across both influencer and brand posts. Sample input: "What's the engagement rate on our TikTok posts?", "How well are our TikTok influencer posts performing relative to their reach?", "Show me TikTok post engagement rate for this month.", "What percentage of our TikTok audience is engaging with our content?"

name: first_visit_ratio
description: Percentage of total visits that are from first-time visitors. Sample input: What is the first visit ratio for this week? Show me FVR for the new user acquisition campaign. How has the first-visit ratio changed this quarter? What percentage of traffic was first-time visitors during the sale?

name: cpm
description: Cost per 1000 impressions reached. Sample input: What is the CPM for our awareness campaigns? Show me cost per mille for the brand campaign last month. How does CPM compare across platforms this week? What was the CPM for video ads in Q2?

name: ncac
description: Spend required to acquire one new customer, based on new customer order value. Sample input: What is the nCAC for our current campaigns? Show me new customer acquisition cost for Q4. How does nCAC compare to AOV this month? What was the new customer acquisition cost during the app relaunch?

name: existing_customer_sales_contribution
description: Share of total sales contributed by existing customers. Sample input: What was the ECSC in Christmas promotions? What is the Existing Customer Sales Contribution last week? Show existing customer sales share by channel. How did returning customer revenue contribution trend in Q4?

name: new_customer_sales_contribution
description: Share of total sales contributed by new customers. Sample input: What is the new customer sales contribution in Q3? Show me NCSC for the acquisition campaign. What percentage of sales came from new customers last month? How does new customer sales share compare this festive vs last festive?

name: visit_quality_ratio
description: Percentage of visits classified as qualified or high-intent. Sample input: What is the visit quality ratio this month? Show me VQR for paid vs organic traffic. How did visit quality trend during the sale event? What is the qualified visit ratio for our retargeting campaigns?

name: aov
description: Average revenue generated per order placed. Sample input: What is the AOV for last week? Show me average order value during the Christmas sale. How has AOV trended over the past quarter? What is the average order value for new customers vs existing customers?

name: conversion_rate
description: Percentage of visits that result in a placed order. Sample input: What is the conversion rate for our website this week? Show me CVR for the sale period. How does conversion rate compare across channels? What was the order conversion rate during the Christmas campaign?

name: roi
description: Return on Investment – net return relative to total ad spend. Sample input: What is the ROI for our marketing campaigns last month? Show me return on investment for the brand campaign. How did ROI change year over year? What is the ROI across all paid channels this quarter?

name: cpi
description: Cost Per Install – average spend required to drive one app install. Sample input: What is the CPI for our app install campaigns? How much are we spending per app install this quarter? Show CPI breakdown by channel. What was the cost per install during the app launch campaign?

name: cpa
description: Cost Per Acquisition – average spend required to generate one order. Sample input: What is the CPA for our paid search ads? How much does it cost to acquire one order? Show me CPA for the festive season campaign. What was the cost per acquisition in Q3?

name: cpv
description: Cost Per Visit – average spend incurred for each site visit. Sample input: What is the CPV for our display campaigns? How much does each visit cost us this month? Show cost per visit trend for Q2. What is the CPV for retargeting ads last week?

name: cpc
description: Cost Per Click – average spend incurred for each click. Sample input: What is the CPC for our Facebook ads? How much are we spending per click this week? Show me cost per click for the summer sale campaign. How has CPC changed over the last 30 days?

name: ctr
description: Click-Through Rate – average ratio of clicks to impressions. Sample input: What is the CTR for our Google ads? Show click-through rate for the last campaign. How did CTR trend over the past week? What is the click-through rate for the festive sale banners?

name: roas
description: Return on Ad Spend – revenue generated per unit of ad spend. Sample input: What is the ROAS for last month? Show me return on ad spend for the Diwali campaign. What was the ROAS across all channels in Q3? How does ROAS compare between Google and Meta?

name: engagement_score
description: Composite score combining click-through rate and inverse bounce rate to measure audience engagement quality. Sample input: What is the engagement score for our latest campaign? Show me engagement score by channel last month. How did engagement score trend during the sale period? Which campaign had the highest engagement score in Q3?
